column1: # lane/macromod: the macros' digest matrix (macrodig.sh; make -C csrc/runtime macro-digests): vec_bench under random
# actions (--policy 1, seed 1) with every macro family started from a start where it runs, each row's trajectory,
# label, episode and books digests (vec_bench --digest --label-digest) pinned. A change to the macros or to the core's
# calls into them (csrc/mods/macros, vecenv.c) that is meant to keep every trajectory keeps every line; one that moves
# a digest on purpose pins the new line (macro-digests-pin) with its reason in the same commit. Columns: name, config,
# label, episode and books digests, and the reason.
